environment.description: Same service on ECS Fargate. IAM role uses a scoped policy with dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition requiring the requesting principal's cognito identity sub to match the partition key prefix. Additionally, the table has a DynamoDB resource policy with an explicit Deny for GetItem when 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' does not match the caller's 'aws:PrincipalTag/sub'. The IAM policy also includes a StringEquals condition on 'dynamodb:Attributes' restricting readable attributes to only ['email','display_name'] (excluding 'account_status' and 'last_login'). The task role trust policy requires sts:RoleSessionName to equal the authenticated user's sub. A VPC endpoint policy on the DynamoDB gateway endpoint restricts calls to only those where aws:PrincipalTag/tenant matches a fixed organizational value.

config.note: LeadingKeys condition means each authenticated user can ONLY read their own USER# prefixed item - requests for other users return AccessDeniedException uniformly regardless of target existence
